line: Someone copies your idea today. Take it as a compliment, then finish yours first.
Your people find you today. Say yes to the kopi; skip the gossip that comes with it.
Help turns up without asking today. Accept it, and say thank you out loud.
A quiet hunch is right today. Trust it, but double-check the meeting time.
The boss notices your work today. Keep the reply short and the tone kind.
Wednesday pushes a bit today. Do the hardest task before lunch, then breathe.
Good day to sort the bills. Cancel the app subscription you forgot about.
A side chance pops up today. Say maybe, read the fine print, then decide.
You'll want to correct someone today. Pick one battle; let the rest go.
Fun mood today. Share the meme, start the playlist, still hand in the work.
